title: A star in a bottle
subtitle: The record fusion shots of the JET tokamak, predicted from first principles
hook: In 2023 the JET tokamak held a plasma far hotter than the core of the Sun for five seconds and released 69 megajoules of fusion energy. Predict it from first principles.
note: In preparation: the cases, the outputs and their units are written here when the flag opens, and the measured values are sealed at the same moment (tools/flags.py seal).
